messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text:
I got a personal request from one of the league members asking me to mandate games tonight. I won’t mention any names, but he’s drunk at an empty stomach and needs online friends.

Please consider ur neighbors

messages.text: Hey man, I have to go and pick up my son at his weekly d&d meeting, 3-hour epic dragons and stuff I guess, but when I get back I will be toasty enough to maybe give you a holler as long as I'm not too toasty
